'''Royal Protectors''', or '''Royal Guards''', were soldiers in the [[Naddist]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Naddist army|army]], who were specially commissioned with protecting the [[Iziz ruling family|monarchy]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], and their families. In reality, these Royal Protectors were dark side [[Dark side adept/Legends|adepts]], who drew upon the power of the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]] to bolster their strength.

In [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the Protectors were employed by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] to protect both she and her daughter from the [[Beast Riders]], who had staged an [[Raid on the Iziz Royal Palace|assault]] on the [[Iziz Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] of Iziz. They attempted to carry out their mission, but were defeated by the [[Beast Warrior Commando]]s who subsequently abducted Amanoa's daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Galia]].

The Royal Protectors were again active after the [[Battle of Iziz]], when Amanoa had perished. This time they were enlisted by her husband [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]], as guardians for his secret underground stronghold under the Palace of Iziz. These guards were too defeated by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], when they stormed Ommin's lair to rescue the captured [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]].
